name: Armor
description: Armor entity extending base item schema with AC base, dex cap, strength requirement, and stealth penalties.

armor_category.description: Classification of armor determining weight class and dexterity application.

ac_base.description: Base Armor Class provided by this armor (e.g. 11 for Leather, 14 for Breastplate, 18 for Plate).

ac_modifier.description: Armor Class modifier over the base 10 (e.g. +1 for Leather, +4 for Breastplate, +8 for Plate).

dex_cap.description: Maximum dexterity modifier bonus allowed. null = uncapped (light armor), 2 = medium armor cap (+2), 0 = heavy armor (no dex bonus).

strength_requirement.description: Minimum Strength score needed to wear without speed penalty. null or 0 if none.

stealth_disadvantage.description: Whether wearing this armor imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
